item.title: Boys State AAA Championship: Shady Spring 58, Fairmont Sr. 55
item.description: WVSSAC Boys High School Basketball Tournament AAA Championship Game. Shady Spring Boys Basketball defeated Fairmont Senior in overtime to win the state AAA championship 58-55. Pictures by Barry Alderman Photography.

item.title: Boys State A Championship: Tug Valley 35, Tucker County 32
item.description: WVSSAC Boys High School Basketball Tournament A Championship Game. Tug Valley High School Panthers defeated Tucker County 35-32 to capture the A state championship. Pictures by Barry Alderman Photography.

item.title: Boys State AAAA Championships: Morgantown 35, Spring Mills 32
item.description: WVSSAC Boys High School Tournament AAAA Championship Game. Morgantown High School needed overtime to defeat Spring Mills 35-32 to capture the AAAA State Championship. Pictures by Barry Alderman.
